## Unsequenced expressions with ≥2 RNG-consuming operands

C leaves the order unspecified; the oracle patch pins the stock gcc order and the port must match it.

- `daemons.c:73` in `rollwand`: `fuse(swander, 0, WANDERTIME, BEFORE)` — safe: BEFORE/AFTER are spread(1)/spread(2) = rnd(0), which consumes nothing; only the time argument draws
- `daemons.c:None` in `stomach`: `ring_eat(LEFT) + ring_eat(RIGHT)` — pinned: stock gcc -O0/-O2 calls LEFT first; oracle.patch makes it explicit; the port calls LEFT then RIGHT
- `fight.c:283` in `attack`: `GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC` — safe: identical-range draws that are summed; any order gives the same total and the same final seed
- `fight.c:283` in `attack`: `GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC` — safe: identical-range draws that are summed; any order gives the same total and the same final seed
- `fight.c:283` in `attack`: `GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC` — safe: identical-range draws that are summed; any order gives the same total and the same final seed
- `fight.c:654` in `killed`: `GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC
				     + GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC` — safe: identical-range draws that are summed; any order gives the same total and the same final seed
- `fight.c:654` in `killed`: `GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC

- `fight.c:654` in `killed`: `GOLDCALC + GOLDCALC` — safe: identical-range draws that are summed; any order gives the same total and the same final seed
- `main.c:149` in `main`: `fuse(swander, 0, WANDERTIME, AFTER)` — safe: BEFORE/AFTER are spread(1)/spread(2) = rnd(0), which consumes nothing; only the time argument draws
- `misc.c:397` in `add_haste`: `fuse(nohaste, 0, rnd(4)+4, AFTER)` — safe: BEFORE/AFTER are spread(1)/spread(2) = rnd(0), which consumes nothing; only the time argument draws
